title: DevBox profile
description: Defaults of a team or company: settings (optionally locked), plugins, prepared credential instances, groups, setup order, branding and repositories. A profile cannot run scripts.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this file follows.

id.description: Profile ID; shown as origin profile:<id>, e.g. for locked values.

plugins.description: Plugins the profile requires from catalogs, switches on or switches off.

require.description: Plugins to install from a catalog, keyed by plugin ID.

catalog.description: Name of the catalog entry in repositories.

enable.description: IDs of plugins to switch on.

disable.description: IDs of plugins to switch off.

credentials.description: Prepared credential instances keyed by instance name; only the secret is missing.

groups.description: Action groups keyed by group ID; replaces the contributions of the plugins to a group with the same ID.

setup.description: Order of the first-run setup: actions (<plugin>.<action>) and credential instances (credentials:<name>).

title.description: Title in header and browser tab.

accent.description: Accent colour from the zenit-ui accents.

logo.description: Logo as SVG path data; sanitised before use.

ui.description: Defaults for the language of UI, CLI and terminal menu. Appearance (title, accent) is set under branding.

language.description: Language code for UI, CLI and terminal menu, e.g. de or en.
language.$comment: Must match an installed language pack; checked when loading, not in the schema.

repositories.description: Repositories for plugins, catalogs, profiles, project templates and system packages that the profile adds for the team, keyed by name.

setting.description: A setting value set by the profile.

value.description: The value; its type is checked against the plugin manifest when loading.

locked.description: User, environment and command line cannot override the value.

credential.description: A credential instance prepared by the profile.

type.description: Credential type, e.g. registry, git-host, ssh-key or generic.

fields.description: Preset field values; field names and types are defined by the credential type.

locked.description: Names of fields that cannot be changed.

consumers.description: Plugins that write the instance into their tools, keyed by plugin ID, with consumer options.

repository.description: A repository with plugins, a catalog, a profile, project templates or system packages. The key of the entry is its ID in CLI, API and UI.

source.description: Location: git+https://, git+ssh://, git+file:// (a local Git repository), https:// (tarball or index.json) or file://.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit; tags or commits are recommended for teams.

path.description: Sub-directory or file inside the source.

credential.description: Name of a credential instance (git-host or registry) for private repositories. The secret is passed only to Git or the download, never to plugins.

trust.description: How code from the repository is released: an object with a Sigstore identity (signature required), "prompt" (show and confirm permissions for every new version) or "pinned" (only the commit named in ref, without asking).

format.description: Package format of a packages repository.

url.description: Base URL of a packages repository.

suite.description: Suite of a packages repository, e.g. the distribution codename (apt).

key.description: URL of the signing key of a packages repository.

when.description: Limits the entry to distributions or architectures.

distro.description: Distribution IDs, e.g. ubuntu, debian, fedora.

locked.description: Set in a profile: an entry with the same name in the user configuration does not override this one.

repository.$comment: AP-27 adds if/then: packages requires format, url and key; all other kinds require source.

trust.description: Expected Sigstore signing identity; a valid signature is required.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer of the signing certificate.

identity.description: Certificate identity, e.g. the URL of the release workflow.
